evidence_class: fakeredis swarm store, inbox and masters channel, a fake herdr runtime and a fixture ledger document with sixteen phases, growing from five to twenty agents and back; no live swarm. Live G10 qualification is separate.
interfaces: agentihooks swarm SLUG set master-per=N|hive|off: stores the scaling rule beside the master seat count after every other pair is checked; anything else is refused by name and stores nothing; off keeps the manual masters=N count
master_scale.wanted(rule, agents): one master seat per N working agents rounded up, or one per distinct hive, with a floor of one; masters and finished agents never count

master_scale.run, the tick pass: raises the count at once, holds a shrink for HOLD_MS, asks each extra seat's live master once to hand off, lowers the count only past seats whose master left, forwards a retired seat's handoff and open items to the lead, then calls master_fill.run with a limit so a retiring seat is never refilled
MastersChannel.announce(slug, text, at): a post by the tick itself, seat and author swarm, carrying the new phase owners after each count change

masters.is_lead(slug, agent): every single master lookup in the tick, tick_master, affinity, control_notifications and take_master reads only the lead seat, so an extra master never stands in for the lead

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards on the pull request
supported_versions.compatibility: A swarm with no rule keeps its manual master count and routes exactly as SV2-MST-01 left it (INV-R11); a single master swarm launches no extra seat

states.observed: The wanted count is computed from the working agents and the rule on every tick
states.committed: The count, the rule, the shrink start, the retiring seats with their ask item and the retire seconds are written to the swarm's masters hash; owners are rebalanced by MasterSeats.owners under its watch
states.externally_verified: None; no live multi master swarm on Anton yet

authoritative_objects: The swarm masters hash in Redis holds the seat count, the scaling rule, the shrink start and the retiring seats
The masters channel list holds each count change announcement
The ledger document stays the single writer of phases and tasks; this package never writes it

rollback_rehearsal.action: agentihooks swarm SLUG set master-per=off: the count stays where the operator sets it with masters=N and the tick only fills its seats
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: A retired seat's handoff and open items move to the lead; no inbox item, handoff or ledger record is deleted

remaining_limitations: Measurements are kept in the masters hash and returned by master_scale.measurements; they are not shipped to the metrics outbox yet, proposed as a ledger follow up

Extra master seats are stored as working rather than starting, because only the lead has a start tracker; a seat whose process is gone is reaped as lost once the startup grace from its spawn has passed, then no longer counts as occupied, and its seat refills
Owner fenced writes between masters are SV2-MST-04

Phases of an emptied lower seat stay assigned to it in the masters hash until the count falls past it; the tick posts on the masters channel that the lead answers them, and masters.route sends their items to the lead, because their owner seat has no live master

decisions: A grow raises the count at once; a shrink waits HOLD_MS so a brief dip never cycles masters
The count falls only to the highest extra seat that still holds a live master, so no seat is cut mid answer
A retired seat moves every open item to the lead, read ones included, because an item a departed master read but never closed would otherwise be stranded
Regrowth after the asks withdraws them and keeps every seat
An extra seat below a live higher seat that empties after its ask forwards its handoff and open items to the lead at once; the count still falls only past seats whose master left

input_preparation.met_by: tests/sv2_mst03_cases.py builds the five to twenty and back swarm from tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/master-scaling.json

output_contract.met_by: Twenty agents at one seat per five give four seats, three launched masters, four phases each and one announcement

rejection_contract.met_by: An unknown rule is refused by name; a shrink inside the hold window or with live extra masters never lowers the count; a retire ask goes once

recovery_contract.met_by: Twenty back to five returns the count to one once each extra master hands off; the handoffs and pending items reach the lead and a restart reads the same owners

mutation_scope.met_by: Only the swarm masters hash, master agent records, inbox items and masters channel posts change
